name: WebHarbor
notes: Prebuilt images on Docker Hub (about 20 GB for all sites); tasks are in Harbor format on Hugging Face with train, test and WebVoyager splits, and harnesses for browser-use, OpenCode and OpenWebRL are in harbor/. The authors report a 75.8 average for WebHarbor-4B on WebVoyager and Online-Mind2Web.
summary: Docker-based local mirrors of 153 real websites with auth and databases, plus 3,518 tasks with verifiers for evaluating and RL-training GUI web agents, and a control plane for sub-second site resets.
